statement: For any natural radix, a multiset of endpoint tags in Fin radix squared has full-label incidence sum twice its edge cardinality; a separately labeled old-vertex multiset with P packet vertices per group has total vertex count card(old)+radix*P. Parallel incidences retain multiplicity. Three study declarations instantiate the existing shared multiset laws; no Rust refinement, bit-cost or production-admission theorem is asserted. Focused Lean4.35/Mathlib56 gates and fresh replay pass; default Mathlibcfc qualification and signed standing remain open.
